inventory_count.description: Stage-A: total lightweight listing records scanned (no detail page opened).

unseen_inventory_count.description: Stage-A/B boundary: inventory identities not already in state/seen_source_jobs.json (or a clearly-signaled repost), eligible for a detail fetch.

previously_processed_count.description: Inventory identities already recorded in state/seen_source_jobs.json; their detail pages were not re-fetched.

detail_fetch_count.description: Stage-B: number of detail pages actually opened this run (should equal len(postings)).

inventory.description: Stage-A lightweight scan of every listing encountered this run, used only to refresh source-history freshness -- not fed into classification.

postings.description: Stage-B: only unseen (or clearly-reposted) postings with full detail. This is what classification/ranking/reporting consume.

stage_a_exclusion_reason.description: Optional short reason string. When processing_status is excluded_title_reject: which unconditional Stage-A title check matched (senior_title, marketing_role_title, sales_role_title, hr_role_title). When excluded_out_of_scope: a brief note on why the posting was judged outside the source's required_scope (e.g. not actually Cloud-scoped).

repost_signal.description: Set by the scraper only when the source site itself explicitly indicates this listing was reposted/renewed.
